convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for VolatilityQuality indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Custom indicator with proprietary smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) cannot be auto-converted.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warm-up
TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of the indicator timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open time reference

derived_values.name: UpSignalTime - timestamp for buy signal bar
DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar

other_exits: BuyPosClose flag triggered when VolatilityQuality buffer 1[1]==1 (sell signal state), SellPosClose flag triggered when buffer 1[1]==0 (buy signal state)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=percentage of free margin, BALANCE=percentage of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=percentage of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=percentage of balance minus loss. The MM parameter (0.1) serves as either lot size or percentage depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic is state-machine based on VolatilityQuality indicator buffer values (0=up state, 1=down state). Buy signal fires when buffer[1]==0 and buffer[0]==1 (transition from no-signal to buy). Sell signal fires when buffer[1]==1 and buffer[0]==0 (transition from no-signal to sell). Signal evaluation only occurs on new bars (NB.IsNewBar) or when Recount is true. If SignalBar==0, signals are evaluated every tick. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs act as feature toggles to enable/disable each trade direction and close action independently. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: The VolatilityQuality custom indicator logic must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. The SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library provides 10+ smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA) - these need Python equivalents. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, and GlobalVariableDel_ functions which encapsulate order execution, position checking, and money management - these need Python reimplementations. The MarginMode enum with 5 modes requires careful translation. SL/TP are in points (1000 and 2000) - verify if these need 5-digit adjustment (likely 100 and 200 pips respectively on 5-digit broker). The signal logic uses a discrete 2-state buffer (0/1) with transition detection - straightforward to replicate once the indicator is available.
